<VideoScript />
  <script is:inline>
    (function () {
      var g = document.getElementById('rf-grid'); if (!g) return;
      var items = [].slice.call(g.children), more = document.getElementById('rf-more'), tabs = document.getElementById('rf-tabs'), kind = '', shown = 6;
      function run() {
        var m = items.filter(function (i) { return !kind || i.getAttribute('data-k') === kind; });
        items.forEach(function (i) { i.classList.add('hidden'); });
        m.slice(0, shown).forEach(function (i) { i.classList.remove('hidden'); });
        more.classList.toggle('hidden', m.length <= shown);
      }
      if (tabs) tabs.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var b = e.target.closest('button'); if (!b) return;
        kind = b.getAttribute('data-k'); shown = 6;
        [].forEach.call(tabs.children, function (c) { var on = c === b; c.classList.toggle('on', on); c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false'); });
        run();
      });
      more.addEventListener('click', function () { shown += 6; run(); });
      run();
    })();
  </script>
